newsitem.title: UK: Buoyant UK stocks end at day's highs as Dow climbs.
newsitem.headline: Buoyant UK stocks end at day's highs as Dow climbs.

text.p: The UK stock market ended the week on a firm note, buoyed on Friday by healthy gains on Wall Street and debt markets after U.S. producer price and retail sales data soothed worries about U.S. inflation and interest rates.
The FTSE 100 share index, which spent much of the week defending the 4,000 level, ended at the day's high of 4,028.1, up 33.4 points and just 18.7 points off its all-time high.

"We had a decent recovery in the gilts market, which few had expected, the Dow powering on, and sterling strong. Combined with bid speculation and a steady stream of good company news, the market has put in a solid performance," one trader said.
